name: hubspot-lead-canary
description: Canary leads for HubSpot lead routing: a Cloudflare Worker that submits test leads and checks contact, owner and notification.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply lead-canary-internal --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply lead-canary-client-demo --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/confirm.mjs "Apply D1 migrations to REMOTE databases" && wrangler d1 migrations apply lead-canary-internal --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply lead-canary-client-demo --remote
scripts.deploy: node scripts/confirm.mjs "Deploy Lead Canary worker to Cloudflare" && wrangler deploy
